description: The Settings 'Share with GM' UI and its tests. Depends on FEAT-001 (encodeSharePayload, trimForLink, SHARE_SOFT/HARD_LIMIT, buildCombatStatBlock) and FEAT-002 (the #view/ route the share link targets, so the produced link actually opens the viewer). Adds a new card to SettingsPage with Download snapshot, Copy snapshot, Copy Combat Stat Block, and Copy Share Link, the link-embeds-data privacy note contrasted with the local-only file/clipboard option, the soft/hard length warnings, and feature-detection; plus a new Settings share test file.
steps: Edit src/components/pages/SettingsPage.tsx to add a new Card (alongside the existing Export/Import card) titled for sharing with the GM, reusing characterId (already a prop) and the existing clipboard/download patterns. Controls: Download snapshot — write exportToJSONWithPortrait(character, characterId) JSON to a Blob and download as `<safeName>_share_<timestamp>.json` reusing the existing safeName (name.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g,'_')) + YYYYMMDD-HHmm timestamp construction (do NOT call exportToFile, which omits the portrait); Copy snapshot — same payload via navigator.clipboard.writeText; Copy Combat Stat Block — buildCombatStatBlock(character) via navigator.clipboard.writeText; Copy Share Link — trimForLink(character) -> exportToJSONWithPortrait -> encodeSharePayload -> formatViewHref(location.origin, location.pathname, encoded) copied to clipboard.
Feature-detect CompressionStream: when typeof CompressionStream === 'undefined' disable Copy Share Link and show a hint pointing to the offline snapshot.

Add the privacy note stating the character data is embedded in the link (anyone with the link can read the sheet), visually contrasted with the local-only snapshot (file/clipboard) option which transmits nothing.

Render length warnings measured on the full href from formatViewHref with the >= operator: a soft inline caution when href.length >= SHARE_SOFT_LIMIT (link stays the primary action, still copyable); a structurally distinct element with data-testid='share-hard-warning' when href.length >= SHARE_HARD_LIMIT that demotes Copy Share Link below Download snapshot (making Download snapshot primary, link still copyable). Warning text names the portrait and 'a large sheet (many items or a long log)' as causes; note the portrait is not included in links. Add SettingsPage.module.css styles as needed. Change NO existing control.

Create src/components/pages/__tests__/SettingsShare.test.tsx (new file; do NOT modify existing Settings tests): the three controls appear; Copy Combat Stat Block writes plain text to a mocked clipboard; Copy Share Link writes a #view/... URL and shows the privacy note contrasted with the local-only snapshot; length-warning transition asserted on the full href with >= — just-below-SHARE_SOFT_LIMIT shows neither warning, at/above SHARE_SOFT_LIMIT shows the soft caution with link primary, at/above SHARE_HARD_LIMIT renders data-testid='share-hard-warning' and demotes Copy Share Link so Download snapshot is primary.
acceptance_criteria: Settings shows a snapshot action that downloads a `<safeName>_share_<timestamp>.json` file and copies the same payload to the clipboard; the payload parses with importFromJSON (AC5).

Settings shows a separate Copy Combat Stat Block button that copies plain text (name, combat characteristics, wounds, movement, armour by location, weapons with computed damage/reach/qualities, active conditions) whose numbers match the calculators (AC7).
Settings shows a Copy Share Link action producing a URL whose hash encodes the compressed character (opening it renders the viewer from FEAT-002, client-side, no network) (AC8).

When the full href reaches SHARE_SOFT_LIMIT the soft caution shows with the link still primary; at SHARE_HARD_LIMIT data-testid='share-hard-warning' renders and Download snapshot becomes primary; the link excludes the portrait (AC9).
The share-link UI displays a privacy note stating the data is embedded in the link, visually contrasted with the local-only file/clipboard option (AC10).
verification: vitest --run src/components/pages/__tests__/SettingsShare.test.tsx  (passes); vitest --run  (all existing Settings and other tests still green)
npx eslint .  (0 errors, no new warnings)
findings:
The Settings 'Share with GM' card landed in src/components/pages/SettingsPage.tsx (+ SettingsPage.module.css styles) as an additive new Card placed between the Export/Import card and the Utilities card. No existing control was changed.

Controls (all reuse existing patterns; characterId is already a prop):
- Download snapshot: exportToJSONWithPortrait(character, characterId) -> Blob('application/json') -> anchor download named `<safeName>_share_<timestamp>.json` using the SAME safeName (name.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g,'_')) + YYYYMMDD-HHmm construction as handleExportFile. Does NOT call exportToFile (keeps the portrait). Payload parses with importFromJSON (test asserts).
- Copy snapshot: same exportToJSONWithPortrait payload via navigator.clipboard.writeText.
- Copy Combat Stat Block: buildCombatStatBlock(character) (plain text, numbers from deriveSheetTotals via FEAT-001) via clipboard.
- Copy Share Link: exportToJSONWithPortrait(trimForLink(character), characterId) -> encodeSharePayload -> formatViewHref(location.origin, location.pathname, encoded), copied to clipboard AND shown read-only in a .shareLinkBox <code>. trimForLink strips portrait+eventLog so links stay small; the link targets FEAT-002's #view/ route (test decodes the hash via parseViewRoute).

Feature detection: compressionAvailable = typeof CompressionStream !== 'undefined'. When absent, Copy Share Link is disabled (title + a hint steering to Download/Copy snapshot). The snapshot path never needs gzip.

Privacy note (two contrasted blocks, .sharePrivacyLink vs .sharePrivacyLocal): the link EMBEDS the character data (anyone with the link can read the full sheet, nothing uploaded) vs the snapshot stays LOCAL to this device and transmits nothing until the user sends it.

Length warnings measured on the FULL href (shareLink.length) with the >= operator, consistent with share-portrait.classifyLinkLength: softWarn = len >= SHARE_SOFT_LIMIT, hardWarn = len >= SHARE_HARD_LIMIT. Below SOFT: no warning, Copy Share Link is primary (.sharePrimaryBtn) and precedes Download snapshot in the DOM. At/above SOFT (< HARD): inline soft caution (role=status, 'getting long', names 'a large sheet (many items or a long log)', notes the portrait is not in links); link stays primary. At/above HARD: a structurally distinct element with data-testid='share-hard-warning' (role=alert, border/danger styling) and the action layout flips so Download snapshot becomes primary (.sharePrimaryBtn) and precedes Copy Share Link (demoted below). The warning/link length is driven by shareLink state, so warnings appear after the user generates a link.

No setState-in-effect was needed, so the sanctioned react-hooks/set-state-in-effect eslint-disable was NOT used. No new @ts-ignore / eslint-disable.

New test: src/components/pages/__tests__/SettingsShare.test.tsx (8 tests; existing Settings tests untouched). Mocks navigator.clipboard.writeText and URL.createObjectURL/revokeObjectURL. Covers: the four controls render; privacy note contrast; Copy Combat Stat Block writes plain text equal to buildCombatStatBlock (and is not JSON); Download snapshot Blob payload parses via importFromJSON; Copy Share Link writes a #view/... URL whose hash parses via parseViewRoute; and the soft/hard transition. The length-bucket tests build characters by growing a high-entropy trapping name (trappings survive trimForLink; entropy keeps gzip from shrinking it) and pre-measure the full href via the real encodeSharePayload+formatViewHref to land just-below-SOFT / at-or-above-SOFT-below-HARD / at-or-above-HARD, then assert neither/soft/hard warnings and the primary-action DOM ordering. The jsdom 'Not implemented: navigation to another Document' log is the harmless anchor .click() from the Download snapshot test.

Verification run from d:\Git\PWACharSheet, all clean: `npx tsc --build --force --noEmit` (exit 0); `npm run build` (tsc + vite build succeeded, built in ~726ms, regenerated sw.js); `vitest --run src/components/pages/__tests__/SettingsShare.test.tsx` (8/8 passed); `vitest --run` full suite 5291 passed / 482 files, 0 failed (was 5283/481 after FEAT-002; +8 tests, +1 file); `npx eslint .` 0 errors, 3 warnings (the same pre-existing react-refresh/only-export-components in CommandPaletteContext.tsx, CombatPage.tsx, SettingsPage.tsx — SettingsPage's is the pre-existing `export { loadQuickActions }` line, untouched by this feature).
